title: Cadence vs ModernLoop for recruiting teams
description: ModernLoop automates interview coordination for mid-market TA teams. Cadence covers scheduling end to end for small teams, with GDPR tooling built in.

faq.q: Who is ModernLoop best suited for?
faq.a: Mid-market and enterprise recruiting operations with coordinators or heavy scheduling load: AI-assisted scheduling, scheduling queues, interviewer load balancing, and role-based workflows for coordination teams.

faq.q: What does Cadence cover that a coordination platform is not focused on?
faq.a: The whole small-team loop around the booking: a no-show confirmation cascade, private candidate status pages, consent-gated candidate email, automated retention, and one-click GDPR erasure — designed for teams with no coordinator and no compliance department.
